english.note: This is the all-purpose verb for exceeding something in weight, amount, importance, or value.

exampleSentences.english: I think practicality can sometimes outweigh appearance.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我覺得實用性有時超過外形。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 sat6 jung6 sing3 jau5 si4 ciu1 gwo3 ngoi6 jing4

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when something exceeds an amount, figure, limit, or target.

exampleSentences.english: This bag is heavy enough to exceed the airline's limit.

english.note: Use this when one amount, value, or result becomes greater than another.

exampleSentences.english: This year's company turnover is expected to overtake last year's.
exampleSentences.traditional: 預計今年公司嘅營業額會超過上年。
exampleSentences.jyutping: jyu6 gai3 gam1 nin4 gung1 si1 ge3 jing4 jip6 ngaak6 wui5 ciu1 gwo3 soeng6 nin2
